title: GlossMark boundary manifest
description: A per-directory .gloss.yaml boundary manifest: the architectural boundary the directory belongs to, its level, declared intent relations and the concepts its markers may reference. Mirrors model.Manifest in internal/model/files.go, An unknown key is an error (GM110) at its own line, but the other keys still apply, so the boundary still exists.

boundary.description: The boundary's CURIE (prefix:local-name), for example acme:horse-factory-svc.

level.description: Zoom level of the boundary (model.BoundaryLevels), coarsest first. Default: component.

realizes.description: Concepts this boundary realizes, as CURIEs. The entry inherit means the union of what the nested boundaries declare; other entries add to it. An explicit empty list (realizes: []) declares that the boundary realizes nothing, so any derived realizes is a violation; the same holds for every declared relation (docs/adr/0012-surfaces.md).

holds.description: Concepts whose data lives in this boundary (tables, files, packages): entities, stored measures, event logs; derived from represents on a concept of any kind and compared by gloss drift (docs/adr/0013-data-shapes-and-coverage.md).

presents.description: Concepts this boundary is a UI surface for; compared like realizes, never implies it (docs/adr/0001-presents-and-hosts.md).

hosts.description: Concepts this boundary is a shell or container for; compared like realizes, never implies it.

configures.description: Concepts whose value this boundary edits at runtime (an admin page for a limit); compared like presents, never implies realizes (docs/adr/0012-surfaces.md).

produces.description: Concepts this boundary intends to produce.

consumes.description: Concepts this boundary intends to consume.

publishes.description: Events this boundary intends to publish.

subscribes.description: Events this boundary intends to subscribe to.

default-namespace.description: Prefix assumed for bare (.Local) concept references in markers under this directory.

allowed.description: Concepts that markers under this directory may reference: CURIEs or CURIE globs (impl:Foal*). Optional: when absent the set is derived from what the manifest declares (gloss check --explain). The entry derived keeps the derived set and adds the other entries to it.

generated.description: Globs (relative to this directory) of generated files the scanner ignores.

owner.description: Team or actor that owns the boundary; becomes an owns edge from an actor node.

criticality.description: Governance level of the boundary (docs/GOVERNANCE.md). When unset it is the highest level of the concepts the boundary's code realizes, represents or configures, else its parent's; a boundary that only presents or hosts stays unclassified (docs/adr/0012-surfaces.md).

criticality-floor.description: Make the boundary's criticality a floor for every artifact beneath it, nested boundaries included. Without it an artifact takes only the level of the concepts it links to.

deprecated.description: The boundary is being retired (docs/adr/0007-retiring-boundaries.md). Links into it get GM222 and a HARD gate, as for a deprecated concept.

replaced-by.description: The boundary (CURIE, possibly in another repository) that takes over from a deprecated one.

retire-by.description: The date (YYYY-MM-DD) a deprecated boundary is due to be retired.

stringOrList.description: A single string or a list of strings (model.StringList).

curieGlob.description: A CURIE (zoo:Horse), a CURIE glob where * matches any run of characters (impl:Foal*, impl:*), or derived (the derived set).
